text: Initiate speculative sleeve post-Commerce LOI. Rigetti has Fab-1, 108-qubit GA, and a $100M federal LOI. Revenue declined four years. Stock at 189 times forward sales.

Rigetti is the only superconducting pure-play with an in-house chiplet fab, the 108-qubit Cepheus-1 system live across AWS, Azure, and qBraid, and a $100M Department of Commerce letter of intent. CEO Kulkarni led CyberOptics to a $390M Nordson exit in 2022.

Q1 2026 revenue $4.4 million, up 199 percent. Cash $569 million, no debt. Cepheus-1-108Q deployed April 7. $350 million ATM done June 2025. Quanta $35 million strategic investment. DoC LOI signed May 21.
Top four quantum company per IQT Research, alongside IBM, Quantinuum, and IonQ. Chiplet vs trapped-ion architecture. IonQ is 18 times larger. IBM targets quantum advantage in 2026.
Stock trades at 189 times forward 2027 revenue. Revenue declined four years, from 13.1 million in 2022 to 7.1 million in 2025. Motley Fool predicts stagnation or decline.
80 percent share dilution in 18 months, from 184 to 332 million. The DoC LOI adds federal equity. The ATM remains active. Q1 GAAP income is non-cash from warrant changes.
Quantum advantage 3 to 4 years away per Kulkarni. 108Q at 99.1 percent fidelity vs 99.5 percent target. IBM, Google, and IonQ ahead on revenue or technical milestones.
Initiate speculative sleeve post-Commerce LOI. Size to 1.5 percent. Layer in post-Q2 2026 if revenue confirms inflection. Barbell with IBM and Alphabet.
